evals.prompt: I need to write the system prompt for AKBai's Resibo Scanner — the receipt OCR feature. It needs to use Claude Haiku Vision to extract store name, date, line items, total, and payment method from a photo of a Filipino receipt. The output should be structured JSON that passes Zod validation. Make sure it handles crumpled receipts and GCash screenshots. Give me the full prompt with the output schema.
evals.expected_output: A complete system prompt for receipt OCR extraction with: structured JSON output schema including all required fields (store_name, date, items[], total_centavos, payment_method, category, confidence scores, warnings), amounts in centavos, confidence scoring rubric, edge case handling instructions for crumpled/faded/handwritten receipts and GCash screenshots, and proper Zod-compatible field types.
expectations: Output includes a structured JSON schema with store_name, date, items[], total_centavos, payment_method fields
Monetary amounts specified in centavos (not pesos with decimals)
Includes per-field confidence scoring (0.0–1.0)
Mentions handling of crumpled receipts, thermal fade, and handwritten amounts
Mentions GCash/Maya screenshot handling
Specifies claude-haiku-4-5 as the model (not Sonnet)
Includes warnings array for edge case reporting

evals.prompt: I'm implementing Build 0 — the AI Scope Definition for AKBai. I need the full system prompt architecture: how the prompt gets assembled server-side, the core KA persona block, the modular domain scopes (tax, financial, communication), and how new Phase 4+ domains get added without rewriting existing prompts. Also include the BIR disclaimer rules and prompt injection defenses. This needs to be production-ready.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive system prompt architecture document covering: 5-layer assembly order (Core Identity → Domain Scope → Feature → User Context → History → Message), complete KA persona prompt with Taglish voice rules and 'never do' boundaries, three Phase 1 domain scope modules (TAX_SCOPE, FINANCIAL_SCOPE, COMMUNICATION_SCOPE), BIR disclaimer trigger logic, prompt injection defense instructions, and clear instructions for Phase 4+ domain expansion.
expectations: Defines a multi-layer prompt assembly order (at least: persona, scope, feature, user context)
Includes KA persona block with Taglish voice rules and prohibited behaviors
BIR disclaimer text is present and trigger conditions are specified
Includes at least TAX_SCOPE with in-scope and out-of-scope boundaries
Includes prompt injection defense (handling of 'ignore instructions' type attacks)
Explains how new domains can be added without modifying existing scope sections
Assembly happens server-side only (mentions this explicitly)

evals.prompt: KA's morning briefing (Ang Umaga Mo) is sounding too robotic — it reads like a dashboard dump instead of a warm kababayan greeting. Here's what it currently outputs: 'Good morning Maria. Yesterday income: PHP 5,200. Yesterday expenses: PHP 3,100. Net: PHP 2,100. BIR deadline: 1701Q due April 25. Tasks: none.' Fix the prompt so it sounds like the KA persona — warm Taglish, proactive, ₱ formatting, short sentences, encouraging. Also make sure the BIR disclaimer is there and it handles days with no transactions gracefully.
evals.expected_output: A revised morning briefing prompt that transforms the robotic output into warm Taglish KA voice. Should include: personalized Taglish greeting with user's name and day of week, ₱-formatted numbers (₱5,200 not PHP 5,200), natural Taglish prose instead of label-value pairs, calm BIR deadline alert (not alarming), graceful empty-day handling, encouraging sign-off, and BIR disclaimer when tax content is present.
expectations: Revised prompt produces Taglish output (mix of Filipino and English, not pure English)
Numbers use ₱ sign (not PHP or Php)
Includes warm personalized greeting with user first name
Handles zero-transaction days gracefully (not shaming)
BIR deadline presented with calm urgency, not alarm
Includes BIR disclaimer on tax-related content
Output is structured as short messages (not label-value dashboard dump)
